calendar.title: Calendar Connections
calendar.description: Manage your calendar integrations with Google Calendar or .ics file exports. Your meeting briefs will automatically synchronize to your selected calendar application.
calendar.confirmDisconnect: Are you sure you want to disconnect this calendar? Meeting briefs will no longer be automatically synchronized to your calendar.
calendar.infoText: Calendar connections will automatically add your created meeting briefs to your selected calendar application. Each synchronization is isolated by tenant and user.
